review.summary: No new concrete issues found in the two reviewed test files. The added tests call the public generation functions with the injected provider stub and assert their observable results and error mappings.

checks.detail: The new tests exercise generateGeminiJson and generateAnswerExplanation, including structured result passthrough and the expected quota/schema error types.
The reviewed test code contains no credentials or unsafe external operations; provider calls are stubbed.
The tests assert quota and schema failures through the public service paths.
These tests add no external input boundary; the response schema tests continue to check malformed and oversized values.
The additions cover the public behaviors described in the review request and retain the helper coverage shown in the diff.
No change to production behavior is included in the reviewed diff.
New public-path coverage is present for result passthrough and error classification.
Tests are clearly grouped and use focused assertions; no concrete maintainability issue found.
